transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services, my name is Hannah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Hannah, my name is Linnea Lindqvist. I manage the household bills for my elderly mother, and she discovered this morning that she cannot place international calls to her brother in Toronto, Canada; the line plays an automated tone saying calls to that destination are barred!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Linnea. If I understand correctly, your mother's landline is unable to connect international calls to family in Canada due to an automated call barring message. Before we inspect her exchange routing profile, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly! It is 29 Elm Tree Close, York, YO31 8ZZ, and my mother's landline number is 01904 624810. My security PIN is 3381.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Linnea, that confirms your account details and third-party authority status. Let me check the telephony features active on her exchange line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. She normally speaks with him every Wednesday afternoon, so she is quite worried.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the local exchange switch database for Yorkshire?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Linnea. The exchange routing profile shows that outbound International Call Barring is currently applied to the line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why was an international call bar applied in the first place? She never requested it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our corporate billing platform applies a default international toll protection bar on new residential copper migrations to safeguard against unexpected premium rate charges.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I understand protecting customers from fraud, but she needs to speak with her brother.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can submit an immediate unbarring order to the Openreach exchange network management gateway.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there any charge for removing the international bar?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, removing the international restriction is completely free of charge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What are the standard call rates for calls to landlines and mobiles in Canada?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Standard rate to North America is twenty-four pence per minute, or you can add our International Freedom bolt-on for three pounds a month which gives one thousand inclusive minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let us add the International Freedom bolt-on right now so she does not have to worry about per-minute charges.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added the International Freedom bolt-on to her account billing profile, active from today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will give her wonderful peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously international calling features are barred by default on basic landline tariffs to prevent toll fraud.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that makes total sense for security.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I was in tears this morning because my eighty-two-year-old mother was frantic thinking my brother had had an accident in Canada! She couldn't dial out to him and thought S-Net cut off her phone line! It is so distressing when elderly relatives get terrified by sudden call blocks!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand how alarming and frightening that was for your mother, Linnea. It is incredibly distressing when an elderly family member cannot reach loved ones abroad, and I will personally ensure this international bar is lifted right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Hannah, that is very comforting to hear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Openreach system shows the unbarring instruction has been transmitted to the exchange line card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does it take for the exchange switch to update the routing tables?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exchange line modifications typically propagate within twenty minutes to two hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can we test an outbound call right now from her landline to confirm it works?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Because the digital switch order takes up to two hours to fully propagate through the national routing nodes, a live test cannot be completed while we are on this call.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So we cannot verify right now whether she can definitely dial Canada?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Unfortunately we must allow the carrier propagation window to complete before dialing.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I see. I will have to telephone her later this evening to see if her call goes through.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will document the unbarring reference number on the account notes for you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is that reference number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Openreach network service order reference is OR-INT-44910.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: OR-INT-44910, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Her international rates will automatically reflect the inclusive one thousand Canadian minutes from today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And incoming calls from Canada were never affected by this bar, were they?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, incoming calls from any international country are always delivered without restriction.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know incoming calls are never blocked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will also set a flag on the account preventing any automated re-barring during future system upgrades.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Hannah, that will prevent this from happening again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we finalize the security notes, that York landline was 01904 624810, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 01904 624810 is her home landline.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have settled the interim balance, lifted the bar, and added the International Freedom bolt-on.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That covers everything she needs for her international calling.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The order status displays 'Pending Switch Completion' in the Openreach portal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Understood. I will tell my mother to try calling her brother at four o'clock this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If she experiences any difficulty dialing at four o'clock, she can dial 151 from her landline for immediate routing assistance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 151, got it. Thank you for your thorough help, Hannah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Linnea. It has been a pleasure helping you today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Have a wonderful afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your mother's account I can assist you with today, Linnea?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No thank you, everything is taken care of.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer services, Linnea. Have a great day. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Hannah.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
